habits.boundary_condition: Do not infer that the pool or hot tub must be indoor or outdoor; the indoor preference appears in only one dialogue. Do not treat unrelated one-off trip details such as destination, dates, price, or beach proximity as part of this habit.
habits.condition: When choosing or evaluating a hotel for a leisure stay.
habits.default_action: Prioritize or ask about hotels that offer the full pool-plus-hot-tub-plus-fitness/exercise amenity bundle, and call out clearly if one element is missing.
habits.exception_condition: If otherwise suitable hotels do not offer all three amenities, present close matches while explicitly noting which of pool, hot tub, or fitness/exercise facility is absent.
habits.name: hotel_recreation_and_exercise_amenities
habits.preference_value: Prefers hotels with a pool, hot tub, and fitness/exercise facility.
habits.rationale: Across three distinct hotel conversations and instruction IDs, the user independently requests the same recreation-plus-exercise amenity pattern. Because only one dialogue uses hard requirement wording, this should be modeled as a strong preference rather than an absolute rule.
